function GetPatch($ord) {

{"command":"Set-Location .\workspace
function Inflate($sha) {
  $dir = ".git\objects\" + $sha.Substring(0,2)
  $file = Join-Path $dir $sha.Substring(2)
  if (-not (Test-Path $file)) { return $null }
  $bytes = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllBytes((Resolve-Path $file))
  $ms = New-Object System.IO.MemoryStream
  $ms.Write($bytes, 2, $bytes.Length - 2)
  $ms.Position = 0
  $ds = New-Object System.IO.Compression.DeflateStream($ms, [System.IO.Compression.CompressionMode]::Decompress)
  $sr = New-Object System.IO.StreamReader($ds)
  $text = $sr.ReadToEnd(); $sr.Close()
  return $text
}
function FindBlob($treeSha, $parts) {
  $text = Inflate $treeSha
  $i = $text.IndexOf([char]0)
  $header = $text.Substring(0, $i)
  $body = $text.Substring($i + 1)
  # tree entries: "<mode> <name>\0<20 raw bytes>"
  $rest = $body
  while ($rest.Length -gt 0) {
    $nul = $rest.IndexOf([char]0)
    $meta = $rest.Substring(0, $nul)
    $mode = ($meta -split ' ')[0]
    $name = ($meta -split ' ')[1]
    $raw = $rest.Substring($nul + 1, 20)
    $hex = -join ($raw | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString('x2') })
    if ($parts.Count -eq 1) { if ($name -eq $parts[0]) { return @($mode, $hex) } }
    elseif ($name -eq $parts[0]) { return FindBlob $hex ($parts | Select-Object -Skip 1) }
    $rest = $rest.Substring($nul + 21)
  }
  return $null
